title: ЭЕШ English mock 2024 · Mock 3
subject: English
theme: A spacecraft lost to a units mix-up, honeybees and a hotel stay
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.
note: Follows the 2024 ЭЕШ Variant A, known only from screenshots of a user upload on Scribd, not an official БҮТ file (the official key upload was deleted). Part I 47 items / 80 points, Part II 3 tasks / 20 points. No duration is printed, so durationMinutes is null.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Choose the most suitable word to complete each sentence. /6x1=6 points/

questions.stem: There are ___ chairs in the hall for everyone.
questions.explanation: “chairs” тоологдох олон тооны нэр үг бөгөөд “for everyone” гэсэн нь хүн бүрт хүрэлцэхүйц тоог заах тул “enough” (хангалттай) орно; “much” тоологдохгүй нэр үгтэй, “a lot” нь “of”-гүйгээр нэр үгийн өмнө ордоггүй.

questions.stem: She can't swim, ___?
questions.explanation: Үгүйсгэх “can't” бүхий өгүүлбэрийн хавсралт асуулт эерэг хэлбэртэй, ижил модаль үйл үгтэй байх тул “can she” болно; “does she” нь өөр туслах үйл үг тул тохирохгүй.

questions.stem: You ___ have told me earlier! Now it's too late.
questions.explanation: Өнгөрсөнд хийх ёстой байсан ч хийгээгүй үйлийг зэмлэхдээ “should have” + III хэлбэр хэрэглэнэ; “Now it's too late” гэсэн нь харамсал, зэмлэлийг харуулна, “must have” бол таамаглал.

questions.stem: Would you like ___ dinner with us tonight?
questions.explanation: “Would you like” гэсний дараа инфинитив ордог тул “to have dinner” (оройн хоол идэх) болно; “like doing” хэлбэр “would”-тай хамт урилга илэрхийлэхэд хэрэглэгддэггүй.

questions.stem: The weather today is quite ___ yesterday's.
questions.explanation: Өнөөдрийн цаг агаарыг өчигдрийнхтэй харьцуулахдаа “similar to” (…-тэй төстэй) бүтэц хэрэглэнэ; “same” бол заавал “the same as” гэж хэрэглэгддэг, “alike” араасаа харьцуулах зүйлээ авдаггүй.

questions.stem: My aunt gave me a ___ vase.
questions.explanation: “beautiful” нь сэтгэгдэл илэрхийлдэг тул хамгийн түрүүнд, дараа нь нас “old”, өнгө “blue”, эцэст нь гарал үүсэл “Chinese” орж “beautiful old blue Chinese vase” болно.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the word or phrase that best completes each sentence. /7x2=14 points/

questions.stem: If the engineers ___ the units more carefully, they ___ the spacecraft.
questions.explanation: Сансрын хөлөг алдагдсан нь өнгөрсөнд болсон явдал тул биелээгүй нөхцөлийг 3-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэрээр илэрхийлнэ: “had checked / wouldn't have lost”; бусад хослолд нөхцөл ба үр дүнгийн цаг зөрдөг.

questions.stem: The hotel has two pools, one of ___ is on the roof.
questions.explanation: “two pools” нь юм тул “one of” гэсэн угтвар үгийн дараа харьцангуй төлөөний үг “which” орно; “whom” хүнд хэрэглэгдэж, “that” угтвар үгийн дараа ордоггүй.

questions.stem:
"Where is the nearest bank?" the tourist asked.
The tourist asked ___.

options.D: where the nearest bank is it

questions.explanation: Шууд бус асуултад “Where is the nearest bank?” гэсэн асуултын дараалал хүүрнэх дараалал болж, цаг ухарна: “where the nearest bank was”; “where was the nearest bank” асуултын дараалал хэвээр тул буруу.

questions.stem: The match continued ___ the fact that it was raining.
questions.explanation: “the fact that” гэсэн нэр үгийн хэллэгийн өмнө угтвар үг “despite” орно; “in spite” нь “of”-гүй дутуу, “although” бол шууд бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн өмнө ордог.

questions.stem: We ___ by a professional painter last year.
questions.explanation: Байшингаа өөрсдөө биш мэргэжлийн будагчаар будуулсан тул үйлдүүлэх хэв хэрэглэнэ; “by a professional painter”, “last year” гэсэн нь өнгөрсөн цагаар “had our house painted” болохыг заана.

questions.stem: By the time the police ___, the thieves ___.
questions.explanation: Цагдаа ирэхээс өмнө хулгайчид зугтчихсан байсан тул эрт болсон үйлд өнгөрсөн төгссөн цаг ордог: “arrived / had escaped”; “By the time”-ын дараах хэсэгт өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг хэрэглэнэ.

questions.stem: Bees fly ___ flower ___ flower, collecting nectar ___ their hive.
questions.explanation: “from … to” бүтэц нэг цэцгээс нөгөө рүү шилжихийг, “for” нь зориулалтыг заадаг тул “from / to / for”: зөгий үүрэндээ зориулж нектар цуглуулдаг.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Read the short conversation and choose the appropriate response. There are two extra. /3x2=6 points/
tasks.text:
Anu: I was so tired after the trip.
Tom: 14. _________ I slept for twelve hours.
Anu: I don't want to travel again for a while.
Tom: 15. _________ Home is the best place.
Anu: Have you unpacked your bags?
Tom: 16. _________ They're still in the hall.

questions.explanation: Ану “I was so tired after the trip.” гэж өнгөрсөн цагийн “was”-тай эерэг өгүүлбэр хэлсэн тул Том “So was I.” гэж санал нийлнэ; “Neither was I.” үгүйсгэлд хэрэглэгддэг.
Ану “I don't want to travel again for a while.” гэж үгүйсгэх өгүүлбэр хэлсэн тул Том санал нийлэхдээ ярианы хэлбэрийн “Me neither.” гэнэ; “So do I.” эерэг өгүүлбэрт хэрэглэгдэнэ.
“Have you unpacked your bags?” гэсэн асуултад “They're still in the hall” гэж нэмсэн тул цүнхээ хараахан задлаагүй буюу “Not yet.” гэж хариулна.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the best options that transformed correctly using the KEY WORDS IN BOLD. /2x3=6 points/

questions.stem:
It's too cold to go swimming.
**enough**

options.A: It isn't warm enough to go swimming.
options.B: It isn't enough warm to go swimming.
options.C: It's warm enough to go swimming.
options.D: It isn't cold enough to go swimming.
options.E: Enough cold it is to go swimming.

questions.explanation: “too cold” (хэт хүйтэн) гэсэн утгыг үгүйсгэл ба эсрэг утгатай тэмдэг нэр + “enough”-ээр илэрхийлнэ: “It isn't warm enough to go swimming.”; “enough” тэмдэг нэрийн араас ордог тул “enough warm” буруу.

questions.stem:
"I'll help you," he said to me.
**offered**

options.C: He offered me that he helps.
options.E: He offered help to me tomorrow.

questions.explanation: “I'll help you” гэсэн санал болголтыг “offer” + инфинитиваар дамжуулдаг: “He offered to help me.”; “offered helping” буруу, “offer”-ийн дараа “that” өгүүлбэр ордоггүй.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct word to complete each sentence. /4x1=4 points/

questions.stem: We couldn't see the road because of the thick ___.
questions.explanation: “We couldn't see the road” гэсэн нь харагдац муу байсныг заах тул “thick fog” (өтгөн манан) хоршоо тохирно; “frost” (цан), “hail” (мөндөр) нь замыг ингэж харагдуулахгүй болгодоггүй.

questions.stem: A ___ looks after bees and collects their honey.
questions.explanation: Зөгий тэжээж, балыг нь цуглуулдаг хүнийг “beekeeper” (зөгийчин) гэнэ; “butcher” нь махчин, “tailor” нь оёдолчин.

questions.stem: ___ is the study of living things.
questions.explanation: Амьд биетийг судалдаг шинжлэх ухаан бол “Biology” (биологи); “Chemistry” нь бодисыг, “Physics” нь хөдөлгөөн, энерги зэргийг судалдаг.

questions.stem: Please switch ___ the lights when you leave the room.
questions.explanation: Өрөөнөөс гарахдаа гэрлээ унтраахыг “switch off” гэдэг тул “off” орно; эсрэг утгатай нь “switch on” (асаах).

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the word with different meanings that best fits in all three gaps. /3x1=3 points/
tasks.text:
23. It's not _________ that he got more cake than me.
24. We rode on the big wheel at the _________.
25. She has _________ hair and blue eyes.

questions.explanation: “that he got more cake than me” гэсэн нь шударга бус байдлыг заах тул “fair” (шударга) орж “It's not fair” болно; энэ үг яармаг, цайвар гэсэн утгаараа дараагийн хоёр өгүүлбэрийг ч нөхнө.
“We rode on the big wheel” гэсэн нь зугаа цэнгэлийн тоглоомтой яармагийг заах тул нэр үг “fair” (зугаа цэнгэлийн үзэсгэлэн) орно; “show” энд утгаараа таарахгүй.
Үсний өнгөнд “fair hair” гэдэг нь шаргал, цайвар үс гэсэн утгатай; “blond” энэ өгүүлбэрт таарах боловч бусад хоёр зайг нөхөж чадахгүй тул “fair”.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Find the most suitable phrase for each situation. /2x1=2 points/

questions.stem: What will you need when you go camping in the mountains?

options.B: a tent and a sleeping bag

questions.explanation: Ууланд майхан барьж хоноглоход “a tent and a sleeping bag” (майхан, унтлагын уут) хэрэгтэй; “a business suit”, “high-heeled shoes” нь аялалд тохирохгүй.

questions.stem: What expression is used for *postponing something*?
questions.explanation: “to put off” хэлц үйл үг нь ямар нэг зүйлийг хойшлуулах буюу “postponing something” гэсэн утгатай; “to put on” нь өмсөх, “to put out” нь гал унтраах.

tasks.title: Task 4
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct prefix and suffix that correspond to the following collocations. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem: A(n) ___ + honest answer / loyal friend / obedient child
questions.explanation: “honest”, “loyal”, “obedient” гурвуулаа “dis-” угтвар авч “dishonest” (шударга бус), “disloyal” (үнэнч бус), “disobedient” (дуулгаваргүй) болдог; “un-”, “in-” эдгээртэй таарахгүй.

questions.stem: A comfort(___) + chair / bed / journey
questions.explanation: “comfort” нэр үгэнд “-able” дагавар залгаж “comfortable” (тухтай) тэмдэг нэр үүсэх ба сандал, ор, аялал гурвуулаатай нь хоршино; “-ful”, “-ous” энэ үгтэй нийлдэггүй.

tasks.title: Task 5
tasks.instructions: Fill in the correct preposition for each sentence. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem: The museum is famous ___ its collection of dinosaur bones.
questions.explanation: Ямар нэг зүйлээрээ алдартайг “famous for” гэж илэрхийлдэг тул “for” орж цуглуулгаараа алдартай гэсэн утга гарна; “famous of” гэж хэлдэггүй.

questions.stem: I'm not very good ___ remembering names.
questions.explanation: Ур чадварыг “good at” (…-д сайн) гэж илэрхийлдэг тул “at” орно; угтвар үгийн дараа герунд ордог тул “remembering names” гэж -ing хэлбэртэй байна.

tasks.title: Task 6
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct meaning for each idiom underlined. /2x3=6 points/

questions.stem: After the failure, the engineers had to <u>go back to the drawing board</u>.

options.B: They had to start planning again from the beginning.

questions.explanation: “go back to the drawing board” нь бүтэлгүйтсэний дараа төлөвлөгөөгөө эхнээс нь дахин боловсруулах гэсэн хэвшмэл хэллэг тул “They had to start planning again from the beginning.”

questions.stem: At eighty, my grandfather is still <u>as fit as a fiddle</u>.
questions.explanation: “as fit as a fiddle” нь хийл мэт бүрэн бүтэн, эрүүл чийрэг гэсэн хэвшмэл хэллэг; “At eighty” (наян настай) ч хүчирхэг байгаа тул “He is very healthy.”

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the conversation at a hotel reception and answer the questions. /3x2=6 points/

questions.stem:
Part 1.
Receptionist: Good afternoon. How can I help you?
Guest: I booked a double room for three nights, but your website charged me twice.
Receptionist: I'm sorry about that. Let me check... Yes, I can see two payments.

What is the guest's problem?

options.C: The hotel has no free rooms.
options.D: She paid twice for the same booking.

questions.explanation: Зочин “your website charged me twice” гэж гомдоллож, ажилтан “I can see two payments” гэж баталсан тул “She paid twice for the same booking.”

questions.stem:
Part 2.
Receptionist: I'll cancel the second payment now. It may take three to five days to appear in your account.
Guest: That's fine, as long as I get it back.

What will happen to the second payment?

options.A: It will be paid in cash.
options.C: It will be returned within a few days.
options.D: It will be used for breakfast.
options.E: It will be returned in a month.

questions.explanation: Ажилтан “I'll cancel the second payment now. It may take three to five days to appear in your account” гэсэн тул илүү төлсөн мөнгө хэдэн хоногийн дотор буцаж орно.

questions.stem:
Part 3.
Guest: Also, is it possible to have a room away from the street? I'm a very light sleeper.
Receptionist: Certainly. I'll give you one on the top floor facing the garden. It's much quieter.

Why does the guest want a different room?

options.B: She wants a view of the street.
options.D: She wakes up easily because of noise.
options.E: She wants to be near the restaurant.

questions.explanation: Зочин “I'm a very light sleeper” гэсэн нь чимээнээс амархан сэрдэг гэсэн утгатай тул гудамжнаас хол өрөө хүссэн; ажилтан “It's much quieter” өрөө санал болгожээ.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Read the conversations and fill in the missing phrasal verbs. /2x2=4 points/

questions.stem:
A: What time does your plane leave?
B: It ___ at six, so I have to be at the airport by four.
questions.explanation: Онгоц газраас хөөрөхийг “take off” гэдэг тул “It takes off at six” болно; “takes after” нь хэн нэгэнтэй төстэй байх, “takes over” нь удирдлагыг авах.

questions.stem:
A: Can you ___ the music ___? I'm trying to study.
B: Sorry!
questions.explanation: Хичээлээ хийж байгаа тул хөгжмийн дууг багасгахыг “turn down” гэдэг: зайнуудад “turn, down” орж “turn the music down” болно; “put on” нь асаах, “give up” нь болих.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the article and then answer the questions below. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text:
In December 1998, NASA launched the Mars Climate Orbiter, a spacecraft designed to study the weather on Mars. After a journey of more than nine months, it was due to go into orbit around the planet on 23 September 1999. Instead, it came much too close to Mars and was lost. It probably either burned up in the atmosphere or flew off into space.

At first, nobody understood what had gone wrong. The engineers checked their calculations again and again. The answer, when they found it, was surprisingly simple. One team had calculated the force of the spacecraft's small engine firings in pounds, a unit used in the United States, while the software of another team expected the numbers in newtons, the metric unit. Nobody had noticed the difference.

Because of this mismatch, every small correction to the spacecraft's path was slightly wrong. Over many months, the tiny errors added up, until the orbiter was flying far closer to Mars than planned.

The loss cost around 125 million dollars and years of work. NASA did not blame one person. Instead, it said that the real problem was that the checking process had failed to catch the error. Since then, space agencies have paid much more attention to testing how different teams' work fits together.

Today the story is told in engineering classes all over the world. Its message is simple: the biggest disasters are not always caused by big mistakes, but by small ones that nobody checks.

questions.stem: What is the article about?

options.E: How a mix-up over units caused the loss of a spacecraft

questions.explanation: Өгүүлэл хэмжих нэгжийн андуурлаас болж Ангараг судлах хөлөг алдагдсан тухай тул “How a mix-up over units caused the loss of a spacecraft”; нэг баг “pounds”, нөгөө нь “newtons” хэрэглэжээ.

questions.stem: What was the purpose of the Mars Climate Orbiter?

options.A: To take photos of the Earth
options.C: To study the weather on Mars
options.E: To carry supplies to a space station

questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд хөлгийг “a spacecraft designed to study the weather on Mars” гэж тодорхойлсон тул зорилго нь “To study the weather on Mars”.

questions.stem: What does the article suggest about the cause of the loss?

options.A: Two teams used different units of measurement.
options.E: The weather on Mars was bad.

questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд нэг баг хүчийг “in pounds” тооцсон бол нөгөө багийн программ “expected the numbers in newtons” гэжээ: хоёр баг өөр өөр хэмжих нэгж хэрэглэсэн.

questions.stem: How did NASA react to the loss?

options.C: It stopped all missions to Mars.
options.E: It said the checking process had failed instead of blaming one person.

questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд “NASA did not blame one person” гэж, харин “the checking process had failed to catch the error” гэж мэдэгдсэн гэжээ.

questions.stem: What comparison does the article make in its last paragraph?

options.A: Big disasters and the small mistakes that can cause them

questions.explanation: Сүүлийн догол мөрөнд “the biggest disasters are not always caused by big mistakes, but by small ones that nobody checks” гэж том гамшиг ба жижиг алдааг харьцуулжээ.

questions.stem: What is implied about the small errors in the spacecraft's path?

options.A: They were caused by the weather.
options.D: Each was tiny, but together they became serious over time.

questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд “Over many months, the tiny errors added up” гэж бичсэн: алдаа бүр өчүүхэн байсан ч хуримтлагдаж ноцтой болжээ.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Read again and complete this summary of the article with the following words. There are two extra. /3x3=9 points/
tasks.text: The Mars Climate Orbiter was lost in 1999. One team used pounds, 45. _________ another team's software expected newtons. 46. _________, every small correction to the spacecraft's path was slightly wrong. NASA did not blame one engineer 47. _________ it believed the checking process had failed.

questions.explanation: Нэг баг “pounds”, нөгөө баг “newtons” хэрэглэсэн гэж хоёр зүйлийг эсрэгцүүлж байгаа тул “while” (харин) орно; “unless” нөхцөл, “because” шалтгаан заадаг.
Өмнөх өгүүлбэрт хэлсэн нэгжийн зөрүүний үр дагаврыг өгүүлбэрийн эхэнд таслалтайгаар “As a result,” гэж илэрхийлнэ: “every small correction … was slightly wrong”.
“it believed the checking process had failed” гэсэн бүтэн өгүүлбэр нэг инженерийг буруутгаагүйн шалтгааныг заах тул “because” орно; “in spite of” нь нэр үгтэй хэрэглэгдэж, эсрэгцлийг заана.

tasks.instructions: Read the passage and fill in the gaps with correct word forms. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text: Honeybees live in large colonies that can contain tens of thousands of insects. Each colony has a single queen, whose main job is to lay eggs, while the worker bees do almost everything else. They (a) _________ the young, build the wax comb and defend the hive. When a worker finds a good source of flowers, she returns to the hive and performs a special "waggle dance". The direction and length of the dance tell the other bees (b) _________ where the food is. Bees are also extremely (c) _________ to farmers, because they carry pollen from one flower to another. Without this (d) _________, many fruits and vegetables could not grow. Sadly, bee numbers have fallen in many parts of the world, partly because of disease and the (e) _________ use of chemicals on farms. Scientists warn that protecting bees is (f) _________ for our future food supply.

gaps.label: a
gaps.explanation: “They … the young, build the wax comb” гэж үйл үгс жагссан тул одоо энгийн цагийн үйл үг “feed” (хооллох) орно; “food” нэр үг, “fed” өнгөрсөн цаг тул тохирохгүй.

gaps.label: b
gaps.explanation: “tell the other bees … where the food is” гэсэн утгыг нарийвчлан тодотгож байгаа тул дайвар үг “exactly” (яг, нарийн) орно; “exact” нь тэмдэг нэр.

gaps.label: c
gaps.explanation: “extremely” дайвар үгийн дараа тэмдэг нэр ордог тул “useful” (ашигтай) орж тариаланчдад ашигтай гэсэн утга гарна; “usefully” нь дайвар үг.

gaps.label: d
gaps.explanation: “this”-ийн дараа нэр үг орох бөгөөд цэцгийн тоосыг зөөх үйл явцыг “pollination” (тоосжилт) гэдэг; “pollinator” нь тоос зөөгчийг, “pollinate” нь үйл үг.

gaps.label: e
gaps.explanation: “the … use of chemicals” хэсэгт “use” нэр үгийг тодотгох тэмдэг нэр орох бөгөөд “widespread” (өргөн тархсан) нь “use”-тэй тогтвортой хоршдог; “widely” дайвар үг, “width” нэр үг.

gaps.label: f
gaps.explanation: “is … for our future food supply” бүтэцд холбох үйл үгийн дараа тэмдэг нэр орно: “essential” (зайлшгүй чухал); “essentially” дайвар үг, “essence” нэр үг.

tasks.instructions: Read the passage in 2.1 again and match the words (a-h) to their definitions. There are two extra. The tenth definition is numbered 0. /8x1=8 points/

items.label: a
items.explanation: “colony” (бүл, колони) нь “a group of animals or insects living together”; эхэд зөгий хэдэн арван мянгаараа нэг бүлд хамт амьдардаг гэжээ.

items.label: b
items.explanation: “to lay” нь энд “to produce eggs from the body” буюу өндөглөх гэсэн утгатай; эхэд хатан зөгийн гол үүрэг нь өндөглөх гэжээ.

items.label: c
items.explanation: “to defend” (хамгаалах) нь “to protect someone or something from attack”; ажилчин зөгий үүрээ дайснаас хамгаалдаг.

items.label: d
items.explanation: “source” (эх үүсвэр) нь “a place or thing that something comes from”; эхэд зөгийн хоол олддог цэцэгтэй газрыг ингэж нэрлэжээ.

items.label: e
items.explanation: “direction” (чиглэл) нь “the way in which something moves or points”; бүжгийн чиглэл хоол хаана байгааг бусад зөгийд заадаг.

items.label: f
items.explanation: “pollen” (цэцгийн тоос) нь “a fine yellow powder made by flowers”; зөгий үүнийг нэг цэцгээс нөгөөд зөөснөөр тоосжилт явагддаг.

items.label: g
items.explanation: “disease” (өвчин) нь “an illness” гэдэгтэй ижил утгатай; эхэд зөгийн тоо цөөрсөн шалтгааны нэг нь өвчин гэжээ.

items.label: h
items.explanation: “supply” (нөөц, хангамж) нь “an amount of something that is available to use”; эхэд ирээдүйн хүнсний нөөцийн тухай дурджээ.

tasks.instructions: Read the short passage and find the SYNONYM of the word in bold. /6x1=6 points/
tasks.text: The hotel stands in a (a) **remote** valley, far from any town. Its rooms are (b) **spacious** and bright, and the staff are (c) **courteous** and helpful. Guests can (d) **wander** through the gardens or relax in the (e) **cosy** library. Many visitors say it is the most (f) **tranquil** place they have ever stayed.

gaps.label: a
gaps.explanation: “far from any town” гэсэн тайлбар нь хөндий хотоос алслагдсан болохыг харуулах тул “remote” (алслагдсан) нь “distant”-тай ижил утгатай; “busy” (хөл хөдөлгөөнтэй) нь эсрэг утга.

gaps.label: b
gaps.explanation: “spacious and bright” гэж өрөөг тодорхойлсон тул “spacious” (уудам, өргөн) нь “large”-тэй ижил утгатай; “dark” нь “bright”-тай зөрчилдөнө.

gaps.label: c
gaps.explanation: “courteous and helpful” гэж ажилтнуудыг магтсан тул “courteous” (эелдэг, соёлтой) нь “polite”-тэй ижил; “rude” (бүдүүлэг) нь эсрэг утгатай.

gaps.label: d
gaps.explanation: “wander through the gardens” нь цэцэрлэгээр тайван зугаалж тэнэх гэсэн утгатай тул “wander”-ийн ойролцоо үг нь “stroll”; “rush”, “run” нь яаран хөдлөхийг заана.

gaps.label: e
gaps.explanation: “cosy” нь номын санг тухтай, дулаахан гэж тодорхойлж буй тул “comfortable”-тэй ижил утгатай; зочид тэнд “relax” буюу амардаг тул “crowded”, “cold” тохирохгүй.

gaps.label: f
gaps.explanation: “tranquil” (нам гүм, амар тайван) нь “peaceful”-тэй ижил утгатай; зочид энэ газрыг “the most … place they have ever stayed” гэж магтжээ, “noisy” нь эсрэг утга.
